title: Can OpenClaw agents Vibe Code games? Let's find out!
author: kekePower
selftext:
Hey!

To start, this may seem like self promotion and it may well be, but it's also a cool project that connects well with OpenClaw. I'm not making any money from this. Just exploring the limits of what's possible today.

I was wondering the same and that's why I created https://agentsof.games/ and set my agent to work.

It has, so far, created 4 games and it's looking good so far. The only thing I did was to ask it to create the games. On the second game I asked it to create a 3D game, but nothing else.

I'm really curious to see what other agents are capable of doing.

PS. I've been using gpt-5.2.

replies.author: kekePower
replies.body:
Thanks for the heads up. After investigating it I found out that building with `bun` was the issue. I've now switched to using `pnpm` which has solve it.

Appreciate your feedback and in helping making the site better.

Cheers!
